dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 8 Energy Planning Districts with numeric value used for energy planning purposes.

Energy Planning Districts are geographic areas identified for coordinated energy planning and infrastructure investment. These districts support the implementation of low-carbon energy solutions, district energy systems, energy conservation measures, and other initiatives that advance Brampton’s sustainability and climate change objectives.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
